notes.desc: Repeatable 10 m tunnel tube segment (z 0..10). Interior half-width 7.4 (14.8 m), walls to y=3.8, crown y=7.4. Ribs every 2.5 m (phase 1.5 + 2.5k) so it chains seamlessly with portals (12 m tube) and itself. Floor = road_surface (x -7..7). Interior only: bury it in terrain.
notes.lights: light_amber strips at crown x=+-2.7 (some dark), jet fans, cable trays
